Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Registration with every allowed title - Hobbs, Phase Eight, Whistles, Inside Story
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Use a new email alias for each registration (e.g. name+qa1@domain). Allowed titles: Miss, Mrs, Ms, Mr, Mx, Dr, Prof.
Steps:
1. Open /account/register/ on each brand.
2. Select a title from the dropdown and fill in the rest of the form.
3. Submit the registration.
4. Repeat with a different allowed title.
Expected: The account is created and the user lands on the account area (Inside Story has no My Details page on dev).

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Edit title in My Details - Hobbs, Phase Eight, Whistles
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Registered test account on each brand. Whistles posts to Account-SaveDetails; Hobbs and Phase Eight to Account-SaveProfile.
Steps:
1. Log in and open /account/details/.
2. Change the title to another allowed value.
3. Enter the current password and save.
4. Reload the page.
Expected: The details are saved and the new title is selected after reloading.

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Title outside the allowed list is rejected on save
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Logged-in test account. A value outside the list can be sent by adding an option to the dropdown with DevTools, or by sending the request directly.
Steps:
1. Open /account/details/.
2. Add an option with value "Sir" to the title dropdown (DevTools) and select it.
3. Enter the current password and save.
4. Reload the page.
Expected: The save is rejected with "Please select a valid title." and the previous title is kept.

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Title outside the allowed list is rejected on registration
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). New email alias.
Steps:
1. Open /account/register/.
2. Add an option with value "Sir" to the title dropdown (DevTools) and select it.
3. Fill in the rest of the form and submit.
Expected: The registration is rejected with "Please select a valid title." and no account is created.

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Script payload in the title is not stored or executed
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Cloudflare may block obvious script payloads with a 403 before they reach the application, so the application-level validation may need a developer to confirm it with a payload that gets through.
Steps: 1. Try to save a title with a harmless HTML payload, for example x, via DevTools or a direct request. 2. Check the response and the account, checkout and address pages.
Expected: The value is rejected. If it is ever stored, it is shown as plain text and never rendered or executed.

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Wrong current password: error and nothing is saved - Hobbs, Phase Eight, Whistles
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Logged-in test account.
Steps:
1. Open /account/details/.
2. Change the title and enter a wrong current password.
3. Save.
4. Reload the page and check that the password field is empty.
Expected: The error "Does not match the current password" is shown and the change is not saved. After reloading, the password field is empty.

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Password is not exposed in the page - Hobbs and Phase Eight
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Logged-in test account. Chrome DevTools.
Steps:
1. Open /account/details/ and view the page source.
2. Search for the account password in the source, the console, local storage, session storage and cookies.
3. Repeat after a failed save.
Expected: The password is not present in the HTML, scripts or browser storage.

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Title validation on Inside Story (no My Details page on dev)
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Logged-in test account. /account/details/ returns 404 on Inside Story dev, so the checks use direct requests to Account-SaveProfile.
Steps:
1. Send Account-SaveProfile with title "Sir".
2. Send it with a valid title.
3. Send it with a wrong current password.
4. Send a registration with title "Sir".
Expected: "Sir" is rejected with "Please select a valid title." in both cases, the valid title is saved, and the wrong password returns "Does not match the current password".

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Title validation on Damsel in a Dress
Pre-Condition: Dev URL of Damsel in a Dress needed. The brand is in the ticket scope but was not tested yet.
Steps: 1. Repeat the registration, edit and invalid-title checks on Damsel in a Dress.
Expected: The behaviour is the same as on the other brands.

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Title is shown correctly in the account, addresses and checkout
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Test account with a saved title.
Steps:
1. Log in and check the account area and saved addresses.
2. Start a checkout and check the delivery address summary.
Expected: The title is displayed as plain text (e.g. Dr, Ms) and the pages are not broken.

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Already stored invalid titles no longer run
Pre-Condition: Needs test data seeded by a developer: a customer with an invalid or HTML title stored before the fix.
Steps:
1. Log in as that customer.
2. Open the account area, the addresses and the checkout.
Expected: The stored value is shown as text (or ignored) and is not executed. The pages work.

Title: TFGTRS-4303 - Production cleanup job (developer task, per brand)
Pre-Condition: Run by a developer from Business Manager once per brand, after the QA validation. Cannot be tested in dev by QA alone.
Steps:
1. Run the cleanup in report-only mode and note how many customers have an invalid title.
2. Review the report and run it in apply mode.
3. Run the report again.
Expected: The second report shows 0 customers with an invalid title.
